verses.english: Numbered Discourses 10.117
12. The Ceremony of Descent
With Saṅgārava

verses.pali: Atha kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then Saṅgārava the brahmin went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho saṅgāravo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “kiṁ nu kho, bho gotama, orimaṁ tīraṁ, kiṁ pārimaṁ tīran”ti?
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, what is the near shore? And what is the far shore?”

verses.pali: “Micchādiṭṭhi kho, brāhmaṇa, orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammādiṭṭhi pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: “Wrong view is the near shore, brahmin, and right view is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāsaṅkappo orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāsaṅkappo pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong purpose is the near shore, and right purpose is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāvācā orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāvācā pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong speech is the near shore, and right speech is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchākammanto orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammākammanto pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong action is the near shore, and right action is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāājīvo orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāājīvo pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong livelihood is the near shore, and right livelihood is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāvāyāmo orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāvāyāmo pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong effort is the near shore, and right effort is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāsati orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāsati pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong mindfulness is the near shore, and right mindfulness is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāsamādhi orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāsamādhi pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong immersion is the near shore, and right immersion is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāñāṇaṁ orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāñāṇaṁ pārimaṁ tīraṁ;
verses.english: Wrong knowledge is the near shore, and right knowledge is the far shore.

verses.pali: micchāvimutti orimaṁ tīraṁ, sammāvimutti pārimaṁ tīranti.
verses.english: Wrong freedom is the near shore, and right freedom is the far shore.

verses.pali: Idaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, orimaṁ tīraṁ, idaṁ pārimaṁ tīranti.
verses.english: This is the near shore, and this is the far shore.
Few are those among humans
who cross to the far shore.
The rest just run around
on the near shore.
When the teaching is well explained,
those who practice accordingly
are the ones who will cross over
Death’s dominion so hard to pass.
Rid of dark qualities,
an astute person should develop the bright.
Leaving home behind
for the seclusion so hard to enjoy,
try to find satisfaction there,
having left behind sensual pleasures.
Owning nothing, an astute person
would cleanse themselves of mental corruptions.
Those whose minds are rightly developed
in the awakening factors;
who, letting go of attachments,
delight in not grasping:
with defilements ended, brilliant,
they are quenched in this world.”
